clauses.clause: Raid — This creature enters with a +1/+1 counter on it if you attacked this turn.
clauses.evidence: Tree = the compiler's B14-enters-with-counters-if parse. Trace: [cast] in the first main with no attack and [enters during the opponent's turn] both give a plain 3/2 (the false branch, right); no variant attacks first. Packs (pass): goblin_boarders_raid_after_attack - attack, then cast in the postcombat main: one +1/+1 counter, 4/3; goblin_boarders_no_counter_without_your_attack - no attacker declared, and an entry after the OPPONENT attacked: no counter. The second pack kills a mutant draft without TURN_OF YOU.
